name: Auto Decorator
description: One click decorates your level layout: pick a style, tweak its colours, and fill empty space with matching decoration without touching your objects.

density-scale.name: Decoration density
density-scale.description: Multiplies every preset's density. 1.0 = as designed by the preset, lower = sparser, higher = denser.

max-new-objects.name: Max objects per decoration
max-new-objects.description: Hard cap on how many objects one Decorate run may add (structure pieces + decoration + beat objects). The run also never goes over the level's object limit.

preview-max-objects.name: Max objects in a style preview
preview-max-objects.description: Cap for the temporary preview shown while choosing a style.

object-limit.name: Editor object limit
object-limit.description: The object limit of your game version. Decorating never adds objects past this number minus the safety margin.

object-limit-margin.name: Object limit safety margin
object-limit-margin.description: Objects to leave free below the limit, so you can keep building after decorating.

max-cell-y.name: Highest decorated row
max-cell-y.description: Highest grid row (1 row = 30 units) decoration may reach. Objects outside the editor's own bounds are skipped anyway.

deco-editor-layer.name: Editor layer for added objects
deco-editor-layer.description: Put generated objects on this editor layer (0 = leave on the default layer). Handy for hiding or locking them while you keep building.

apply-background-colour.name: Apply Background colour to the level
apply-background-colour.description: When on, the preset's Background colour also recolours the level's background channel.

live-colour-preview.name: Show colours in the editor immediately
live-colour-preview.description: Applies the palette to the editor view as soon as objects are added. Turn off if colours ever look wrong; the colour triggers still colour the level when played.

random-seed.name: Fixed random seed
random-seed.description: 0 = results are repeatable per preset and level (undo + decorate again gives a new variation). Any other number pins the seed.

button-offset-x.name: Toolbar button offset X
button-offset-x.description: Nudge the Auto Deco toolbar button horizontally (takes effect next time the editor opens).

button-offset-y.name: Toolbar button offset Y
button-offset-y.description: Nudge the Auto Deco toolbar button vertically (takes effect next time the editor opens).
